english.title: On vessel within British fishery limits prevent compliance with requirement or answer to question under section 27
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on a vessel within British fishery limits, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..),

(A)_[prevented]_
(B)_[attempted to prevent]_

a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), from

(C)_[complying with a requirement imposed,]_
(D)_[answering a question asked,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT OR QUESTION..), by **(,,SPECIFY OFFICER..), a British sea-fishery officer, under section 27 of the Fisheries Act 1981
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(2A)(b) and (4) of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968.
